company.name: Costream
company.shortDescription: Costream develops AI-powered software products for indexing and searching human dialogue.
company.description: Costream develops artificial intelligence software that indexes and structures human dialogue. The company focuses on turning audio and conversational interactions into searchable knowledge using machine learning and natural language processing. Its products process unstructured dialogue streams to create organized archives that support contextual search and discovery. Costream serves consumer and commercial software use cases where users need to retrieve information from past conversations. The platform emphasizes transforming spoken communication into structured data that can be queried and analyzed for insights.
